description:
VP, Implementation Program Management

  • Location: Austin, TX preferred; relocation available

  • Schedule: Full-time

  • Travel: As needed for partner, court, field, and internal operating engagements

  • Manages Others: Yes

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. A law degree or MBA is a significant plus. PM certifications and/or six sigma background also helpful

  • Experience: Progressive leadership in complex program management, or operational delivery, including responsibility for people and a multi-program portfolio

Job Overview

BusPatrol is seeking a VP, Implementation Program Management to lead and scale the function responsible for bringing public safety programs from signed agreement and readiness through installation, warning period, live ticketing, stabilization, and transition into ongoing operations.

This leader owns portfolio-level implementation performance for exceptional quality delivery to our partners: the operating standard, prioritization, readiness controls, capacity planning, team development, executive visibility, and continuous improvement. This executive navigates (a) state law requirements, (b) local law requirements, (c) contractual requirements, (d) partner operating needs, and company capabilities to build and execute an integrated plan to launch programs. The role brings structure to complex, cross-functional work while protecting partner trust, compliance, launch quality, and sustainable business outcomes.

This person leads their team in close partnership across internal functions and collaborates with Sales, Operating teams, Technical teams, and Regional Vice Presidents on external partner conversations which may include school districts, law enforcement, courts, and municipalities.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Leadership and Delivery

  • Own the implementation portfolio and establish priorities based on partner commitments, readiness, risk, strategic importance, delivery capacity, and business impact.

  • Maintain an integrated view of state readiness criteria, program intake, active implementations, warning periods, go-lives, stabilization, and handoffs.

  • Set portfolio goals, operating standards, performance measures, and review cadence aligned to Government Operations and company objectives.

  • Understand the impact of commitments and requirements on the business, and navigate partners and internal teams to scalable and efficient solutions that meet acceptance criteria

  • Partner with other departments to translate agreements, legal and regulatory requirements, local operating rules, and partner expectations into executable plans, milestones, workstreams, DACI/RACI ownership, and acceptance criteria.

  • Ensure all business rules, responsibility matrices, process flows, correspondence, training, finance and payment setup, technical configurations, installation plans, and operational workflows are complete, approved, current, and usable by delivery teams.

End-to-End Implementation Scalability and Governance

  • Continuously improve the speed, quality, and predictability of the contract-to-go-live process

  • Lead a consistent lifecycle from the sales-to-implementation handoff through partner kickoff, build and installation, warning period, live ticketing, stabilization, and transition to account management.

  • Route changes through a documented review and approval process.

Cross-Functional Execution and Escalation

  • Align functional leaders and teams around shared outcomes, clear ownership, due dates, handoffs, and decision rights.

  • Identify cross-functional dependencies and critical-path risks early; secure decisions, resources, and mitigation plans before they become launch or partner issues.

  • Escalate material risks with concise facts, impact, options, recommendation, decision owner, and required-by date.

  • Coordinate time-sensitive or emergent work while protecting program continuity and quality.

  • Maintain trusted partner relationships through disciplined expectation-setting, timely issue ownership, transparent status, and coordinated communications across BusPatrol teams.

Systems, Documentation, and Operating Cadence

  • Maintain Jira and related portfolio views as the current execution layer for actions, owners, due dates, dependencies, risks, decisions, and status; ensure the information supports reliable leadership decisions.

  • Maintain durable program records for approved rules, contracts and commitments, correspondence, process maps, operating guidance, readiness evidence, launch decisions, transitions, and lessons learned.

  • Continuously define what “done” means for recurring work and program deliverables, including quality criteria, required approvals, evidence, ownership, and storage location.

  • Set and lead the implementation operating cadence, including portfolio reviews, focused cross-functional working sessions, launch-readiness reviews, escalations, and post-launch reviews.

Readiness, Launch Quality, and Continuous Improvement

  • Protect launch quality by confirming that applicable approvals, training, hardware and software setup, workflows, queues, customer communications, and support coverage are ready before warning or live ticketing.

  • Lead stabilization and warm handoff to ongoing account and operational owners while retaining accountability for outstanding implementation commitments.

  • Conduct structured post-launch reviews and root-cause analysis; convert lessons, recurring defects, missed dependencies, and partner feedback into measurable changes to standards, templates, systems, and upstream handoffs.

  • Balance speed to launch with compliance, partner experience, service continuity, implementation capacity, and program economics.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive experience in implementation, program management, or operational delivery including:

  • At least 5 years in customer-facing implementation roles serving state, local, and federal government customers

  • At least 5 years managing implementation, project, or program managers with responsibility for team performance, capacity planning, and professional development

  • Experience serving as the senior company point of contact for executive stakeholders through complex implementations, launches, and transitions to ongoing operations

  • Experience leading programs or contracts valued at $10m or more and/or managing multi-agency departments

  • Demonstrated ability to translate contractual, regulatory, technical, financial, or operational requirements into integrated plans and controlled execution

  • Experience establishing governance, readiness reviews, operating cadences, standards, and continuous improvement routinse

  • Experience working with public-sector, regulated, compliance-sensitive, or similarly complex customers

  • Excellence executive written, verbal, and partner-facing communication skills

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered. A law degree, MBA, project management certification, or Six Sigma background is a plus

Core Skills

  • Advanced project and portfolio control: critical paths, dependencies, milestones, and change across concurrent programs nationwide

  • Finds joy in deep-dive auditing: scrutinize requirements, communications, and flows in complex systems

  • Exceptional attention to detail: validate commitments, data, workflows, and completion; catch small misses with material impact

  • Critical thinking and analysis: test assumptions, reconcile conflicts, trace root causes and downstream risks, and distinguish facts from forecasts

  • Execution discipline and accountability: turn objectives into prioritized work, clear owners, deadlines, and follow-through

  • Risk, change, and escalation management: anticipate blockers, mitigate risk, and drive timely decisions

  • Governance, communication, and continuous improvement: maintain traceable records, deliver decision-ready updates, and turn findings into stronger controls

Why BusPatrol?

Who We Are

At BusPatrol, safety isn’t just a priority — it’s our mission.

As the nation’s most trusted school bus stop-arm technology solution, we serve over 350 school districts, protecting nearly 2 million students across 30,000 buses.

Every day, millions of children rely on school buses to get to and from school safely, yet reckless drivers continue to put them at risk.

As a technology company with a unique focus on public safety, we use cutting-edge AI, machine learning, and telematics to improve school bus safety.

Our all-in-one safety program equips school bus fleets with AI-powered cameras, cloud-based data management, and an integrated software platform to capture and process stop-arm violations.

Our safety programs foster accountability and reduce dangerous driving behavior in communities across the country.

By partnering with school districts, municipalities, and law enforcement, we make safety solutions more accessible and effective, ensuring that every child’s journey to and from school is as safe as possible.

What We Offer

When you join BusPatrol, you are not just taking a job. You are joining a mission-driven team dedicated to making a real impact.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package

  • Unlimited PTO

  • A purpose-driven career, working to protect children and improve public safety

  • The opportunity to participate in BusPatrol’s culture of safety, learning, and teamwork

  • A team of innovators, committed to leveraging AI and smart technology for social good

Be Part of Something Bigger

We are looking for a passionate and dedicated team member to help us make roads safer. This is a meaningful opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven company that is using technology to create real change.

At BusPatrol, we foster an inclusive and diverse environment built on integrity, collaboration, and innovation. If you are ready to be part of a team that is deeply committed to safety and community impact, we would love to hear from you.

Together, we can protect students, hold drivers accountable, and build a safer future for all.
